sources.title: Fictional reception coordinator interview — demonstration fixture
sources.text: Willow Desk Dental is a fictional clinic used for software testing. Our reception coordinator explains the consultation booking steps before someone schedules a visit. Visitors can ask reception which forms to bring and how appointment confirmation works. We provide a written appointment confirmation after booking. The entrance is step-free. Our reception team can answer additional booking-process inquiries this week. This statement describes appointment logistics only. No clinical outcome, treatment recommendation, professional credential, price, discount, patient story or opening date is approved for this fictional campaign.
